Create a new metawoRld project

Source: R/project_management.R
create_metawoRld.Rd

Creates the project folder laid out as described in SPEC.md: settings (_metawoRld.yml), forms, prompts, rules, the people list, the search and screening log, submissions/ and data/, a README, website templates and (optionally) a Git repository.

Usage

create_metawoRld(
  path,
  project_name,
  project_description,
  inclusion_criteria = character(0),
  exclusion_criteria = character(0),
  git_init = TRUE,
  website = TRUE,
  license = "CC-BY-4.0",
  ...
)

Arguments

path

Folder to create. Must not exist yet.

project_name

Short name of the review.

project_description

One or two sentences describing the scope.

inclusion_criteria, exclusion_criteria

Character vectors of criteria used for screening.

git_init

Initialise a Git repository? Defaults to TRUE.

website

Add Quarto website templates? Defaults to TRUE.

license

Data license, stored in _metawoRld.yml and in every study's datapackage.json. Defaults to "CC-BY-4.0".

...

Further named values stored in _metawoRld.yml (e.g. search_query = "...").

Value

The project path, invisibly.

Details

The project contains:

  • _metawoRld.yml: project name, description, criteria and other settings.

  • _metawoRld.yml: settings, criteria and spec_version.

  • forms/extraction.yml (what is extracted) and forms/screening.yml. Edit these to fit your review.

  • prompts/: LLM prompts used by DataFindR.

  • _rules.yml, _analyses.yml: vocabulary, value checks and planned analyses.

  • people.yml, searches.yml, records.csv, screening.csv: who works on the review, and the search and screening log.

  • submissions/: staged extractions; data/<study_id>/: accepted data.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
create_metawoRld(
  file.path(tempdir(), "my_review"),
  project_name = "Biomarker X in pregnancy",
  project_description = "Living review of maternal serum levels of X.",
  inclusion_criteria = c("Human pregnancy", "Serum or plasma levels of X reported"),
  exclusion_criteria = c("Animal study", "Review or case report")
)
} # }
